info.title: Conjunto Ficticio de Prueba
info.description:
### Title: Conjunto Ficticio de Prueba

**Content**
1. **Destinations**: Fictitious destinations, including type of destination (beach, mountain, historical site, etc.), popularity and best time to visit.

2. **Users**: Fictitious profiles of users including their preferences. This fixture has been enriched with gender diversity.

3. **Reviews**: Fictitious reviews and ratings for the destinations.

4. **User History**: Fictitious records of past visits and ratings.

**Acknowledgements**
This fixture was generated for educational and research purposes.

### Usage
Free to use for tests only.
